categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Tests label and updates unit test coverage in src/test/transaction_tests.cpp.
categories.rationale: Adds coverage for multi-input transactions in `Consensus::CheckTxInputs` where cumulative input values exceed `MAX_MONEY`. As noted in the PR description, a mutation from `||` to `&&` in the `MoneyRange` check previously survived tests because only single-input transactions were exercised.
